user.title: Set up Garden Journal
user.description: Add your plants after setup to get pruning reminders tuned to the Dutch climate.

missing_row.title: Garden Journal: {name} needs attention
missing_row.description: {name} points to a plant that is not in the dataset, so its pruning dates are unknown. Reconfigure it to pick the plant again.

ambiguous_genus.title: Garden Journal: {name} needs attention
ambiguous_genus.description: The dataset now has several plants under this genus that are pruned at different times, so {name} cannot be timed from the genus alone. Reconfigure it to pick the exact plant.

missing_borrow.title: Garden Journal: {name} needs attention
missing_borrow.description: {name} borrows its timing from another plant that is not in the dataset, so its pruning dates are unknown. Reconfigure it to set the timing again.

reconfigure.title: Re-pick the plant
reconfigure.description: Search again to change which plant in the dataset this maps to.

disambiguate.title: Which plant is it?
disambiguate.description: These prune at different times, so pick the one you have.

abort.add_from_panel: Plants are added in Garden Journal, in the sidebar on the left.
